summary: The notification feature itself is well implemented — NotificationSetting/NotificationDelivery models with a data-preserving migration, an HMAC-signed BullMQ-retried dispatcher with SSRF checks at save and delivery time, correct wiring into runTask/mergeGateTask/logJobFailure, solid route + unit tests (973 backend tests pass, both builds green). However the PR cannot merge as-is for three reasons: (1) it reverts the already-merged observability feature from main — lib/sentry.ts, docs/observability.md, tests/sentry.test.ts, the @sentry/node dependency, SENTRY_DSN/MONITORED_SECRETS config and error handlers are deleted, and the Prometheus implementation in lib/metrics.ts, worker-health.ts, llm-client.ts, app.ts, worker.ts, docker-compose.yml, .env.example and vitest.config.ts is rewritten back to an older variant, all unrelated to this task; the branch must be rebased onto current main keeping that work intact. (2) The required settings UI is missing: only frontend lib helpers and TanStack hooks were added — there is no NotificationsSection component and no SettingsDialog tab, so channels cannot be added/tested/disabled from the UI (hooks.ts comments even reference a NotificationsSection that does not exist). (3) The README still documents the removed PUT /api/notifications/settings endpoint in its manual checklist and lacks the required webhook documentation (payload schema, signature-verification snippet, retry policy).

issues.comment: The PR deletes the Sentry error-reporting module (plus docs/observability.md, tests/sentry.test.ts, the @sentry/node dependency, SENTRY_DSN/MONITORED_SECRETS in config.ts, and the error handlers in app.ts/worker.ts) and rewrites the Prometheus metrics implementation in lib/metrics.ts, routes/metrics.ts, worker-health.ts, llm-client.ts, app.ts, worker.ts, docker-compose.yml, backend/.env.example and vitest.config.ts back to an older variant. This regresses the observability feature already merged on main and is unrelated to notifications — rebase onto current main and drop all of these reversions; the diff should contain only notification-related changes.

Missing the required Notifications settings section: no NotificationsSection component exists and no tab was added here, so the channel CRUD/test/disable UI (task step 6) is unreachable. frontend/src/lib/hooks.ts and notification-channels.ts are dead code without it (their comments reference a 'NotificationsSection' that was never created).

The manual checklist still tells users to 'set a webhook URL via PUT /api/notifications/settings', an endpoint this PR removes (replaced by /api/notifications/channels). Update it, and add the required webhook documentation: payload schema per event type, the X-Lemniscate-Signature HMAC verification snippet, and the retry policy (3 attempts, exponential backoff) — task step 7.
